text:
Rowan: Postmortem follow-up: we need concrete owners and a tight timeline for the GPU capacity/autoscale work. Main items: cloud quota request, scheduler knob experiments, 72h soak with alerts, and explicit rollback triggers. Proposal: Jia -> quota, Omar -> scheduler, Leah -> soak/dashboards.

Jia: I can own quota. Please confirm exact GPU types (A100 vs H100) and per-region targets; will submit ticket once provided.

Omar: For scheduler I want two controlled experiments: change fair_share_weight to 0.9 and preempt_threshold to 0.55. Dry-run first (no quota change). Capture scheduler traces and fair_share_imbalance metric.

Leah: I'll build the soak dashboard (p95/p99 latency, queue_length, backlog_rate, preempt_rate, eviction_count). Alerts: backlog_rate>10% for 5m and p99>2s for 3m. I'll set a 30m ops check cadence for the 72h soak.

Rowan: Timeline: plan doc in 48h, dry-run next week, soak window 2025-05-12 to 2025-05-15, 24h rollback window. Agree?

Jia: Sounds good. I'll request canary quota for us-east first.

OpsBot: Created INC-4880 (gpu-quota-request) assigned to Jia, due 2025-05-09.

Omar: Rollback criteria: auto-rollback if fair_share_imbalance > 0.13 for 10m OR preempt_rate spikes > 15% for 5m. Rollback steps: revert scheduler config (git revert <hash>), revoke quota, cordon & drain new nodes. Who executes: infra oncall + Jia for cloud steps.

Leah: I'll attach dashboard links and include exact alert rules in the ticket. Placeholder: https://grafana/internal/d/gpu-soak.

Rowan: Final checklist: Jia files quota ticket with region+type, Omar posts config diffs + dry-run plan, Leah wires dashboards & alerts. Reconvene tomorrow 09:00 to confirm tickets and kickoff dry-run. :thumbsup:
